tools.name: postgrid_list_letters
tools.description: List Print & Mail letters with their status, mailing class, recipient and send date. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/letters.

tools.name: postgrid_get_letter
tools.description: Get one letter by id, including its status, the sender and recipient, the send date and the tracking data. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/letters/{id}.

tools.name: postgrid_create_letter
tools.description: Create and send a physical letter. LIVE keys print and mail it with postage; test keys send nothing. Give exactly one of html, template_id or pdf_url. Recipient and sender are a contact id or an inline contact. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/letters.

tools.name: postgrid_cancel_letter
tools.description: Cancel a letter that is not yet printing. Needs a short note for the audit trail. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/letters/{id}/cancellation.

tools.name: postgrid_list_contacts
tools.description: List saved postal contacts (address book) with their verification status. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/contacts.

tools.name: postgrid_get_contact
tools.description: Get one saved contact by id, with its address and verification status. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: postgrid_create_contact
tools.description: Save a postal contact to the address book. PostGrid verifies the address when it saves the contact. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/contacts.

tools.name: postgrid_list_templates
tools.description: List saved letter templates with their description and merge placeholders. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/templates.

tools.name: postgrid_get_template
tools.description: Get one saved template by id, including its HTML. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/templates/{id}.

tools.name: postgrid_verify_address
tools.description: Verify and standardise a US or Canadian postal address. Returns the corrected address and a status. Each call uses 1 PostGrid lookup (billed). Address Verification API: POST /v1/addver/verifications.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: postgrid_get_template · Private data: postgrid_create_letter, postgrid_list_contacts, postgrid_get_contact, postgrid_create_contact · Public sink: postgrid_list_letters, postgrid_get_letter, postgrid_create_letter, postgrid_cancel_letter, postgrid_create_contact, postgrid_verify_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: postgrid_get_template · Private data: postgrid_create_letter, postgrid_list_contacts, postgrid_get_contact, postgrid_create_contact · Public sink: postgrid_list_letters, postgrid_get_letter, postgrid_create_letter, postgrid_cancel_letter, postgrid_create_contact, postgrid_verify_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
